question: Which of the following Indian banks launched contactless wearable payment devices called 'Wear N Pay' in March 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Axis Bank.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Axis Bank has launched a range of wearable contactless payment devices under the brand** Wear ‘N’ Pay.**
 
• The devices comprise different forms of wearables like a **band, key chain, and watch loop.**
 
• The wearables** function like a regular debit card and are directly linked to the bank account **of an Axis Bank customer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Workability**:

 
 
• These wearable devices can be worn easily to carry out **contactless transactions on the go**, Users do not need to carry their smartphones and wallet for payments anymore. 
 
• Customers can use these devices at any merchant that accepts contactless transactions. Users need to wave the device at a POS machine for transactions up to Rs 5,000 and for more than Rs 5,000; a PIN is required.
